theorem.fixed_p_tilt: For J(j)=sum_e j_e and N(j)=sum_e |j_e|, Z_a(Q;h)=Z_a(Q;0) E_{0|Q,a}[exp(hJ-N log cosh h)]. This retains the h-dependent activity normalization required to keep p fixed.
theorem.one_sided_cusp: Global reflection cancels every non-tied linear term. The exact finite-volume right derivative is R'_L(0+)=-sum_{Q:D_Q(0)=0}|D'_Q(0)|/2.
theorem.gradient_boundary: When the edge field is A=d psi, J_A=sum_e A_e j_e equals the full charge pairing sum_v psi_v Q_v. Measured interior charges contribute a record-constant factor, but unmeasured rough-boundary charges remain summed and can change the sector ratio.

thermodynamic_interpretation.zero_field_ensemble: The relevant h=0 observables are the sector-conditioned joint distribution and cumulants of signed field current J, activity N, and the tied-record mass; a clean XY label is neither needed nor established.
thermodynamic_interpretation.order_of_limits: The exponent hJ-N log cosh h is extensive. Fixed h before L tends to infinity and h tending to zero at fixed L need not commute, so finite-volume evenness cannot classify field relevance.
thermodynamic_interpretation.criterion: A thermodynamic response theorem needs size-uniform control of the conditional cumulant-generating functions and of sum over zero-field ties |D'_Q(0)|; neither follows from reflection symmetry alone.
thermodynamic_interpretation.claim_boundary: The result is not a relevance exponent, critical theory, threshold, or monotonicity theorem.
